title: Rotary position embedding
summary: Rotate adjacent coordinate pairs of queries and keys by position times base^(-2i/d), so attention scores depend only on the position gap.

mutants.exponent_i_over_d: Uses the exponent i / d in place of 2i / d, so the frequencies fall too slowly.
mutants.half_split_pairs: Pairs coordinate i with coordinate i + d/2, not the adjacent pair (2i, 2i+1).
mutants.odd_dim_unhandled: Slices every second coordinate to the end, so an odd d gives arrays of different sizes and the code fails.
mutants.rotates_backwards: Swaps the signs of the sin terms, so each pair turns by minus the angle.
mutants.writes_input: Writes the rotated values into x itself and reads a changed value for the second element of each pair.
